items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: there was Young Pickett, also John Brunus Senior, who was with the Tuxedo Brass Band, and Andrew Morgan and those guys.

ctx.x: Yeah, I mean, you coming from what I suspect was more of a R&B, rock and roll kind of background. Yeah, yeah.

I was met with a lot of opposition. I was met with a lot of opposition on, hey, come in and play in that rhythm and blues in the street. They don't want that rhythm and blues in the street. But what you gotta look at is, when I came along and so forth and so on, there was Young Pickett, also John Brunus Senior, who was with the Tuxedo Brass Band, and Andrew Morgan and those guys. And they had, just about the same time as I introduced Second Line to Olympia, Shirley Lee's song and the rhythm and blues feel was,…
I never thought of Kid Howard as well.
